maker_volume.labels: the venue's OWN maker notional, which is the book it pays rebates from -- a better denominator than a sum of our own fills.

coverage.why: this endpoint returned 62 row(s) across 62 symbol(s) and NONE of them is a prediction instrument, so it is the spot/derivatives volume surface and cannot supply a prediction maker denominator

mytrades_unscoped.caveat: this is our execution record, not the venue's rebate book, and it is bounded by whatever retention the endpoint applies. Reported as a separate candidate denominator, never silently substituted.

economics.labels: aggregate economics only. The credit surface names no fills, so no fill-level attribution exists and none is fabricated.
economics.why: the venue reports NO maker notional on prediction instruments for the period read, so there is no defensible denominator. A credit with no measurable volume behind it is recorded as an aggregate and left unrated.
